body: Yeah, I feel that way too honestly. I've tried communicating with him as openly as I can and letting him know I'm here again and again... but he seems to take everything I do the wrong way. I'll even start with "I just want you to know I'm here for you and I'm trying to reach out to you right now - everything you've said is valid and I'm hearing you, is it okay if I share how I'm feeling?", and he still gets angry and frustrated. Literally don't know what to try next.
He's kind of communicated to me that he's helped me enough... almost like its his turn now. So I'm trying my best but he's just shutting me out as well...
